examples.title: AI governance invitation
examples.before: Your company is already behind on AI. Book a call now before your competitors make you irrelevant.
examples.after: If your team is deciding where AI belongs, begin with one workflow, its evidence, its owner, and its stop conditions. The linked checklist shows the review sequence; a call is optional.
decisions: Evidence: replaces an unsupported competitive threat with a defined operating problem.
Discussion: names the four decision dimensions.
Self-Determination: removes shame and makes contact optional.
Action: offers one inspectable, reversible next step.

examples.title: Health-science explainer
examples.before: This brain hack calms your nervous system in sixty seconds.
examples.after: A slower exhale is used in some paced-breathing practices, but responses vary and this is not treatment. If breathing exercises feel uncomfortable, stop; seek qualified care for symptoms or urgent concerns.
decisions: Evidence: removes an uncited causal guarantee.
Discussion: preserves variability and treatment boundary.
Action: routes consequential concerns to care.

examples.title: Platform-content advice
examples.before: Use this hook and the algorithm will push your video.
examples.after: This opening states the topic and stakes early, which may help a viewer decide whether to continue. Platform distribution depends on changing, personalized systems and is never guaranteed; test the opening against your own audience data.
decisions: Evidence: limits the claim to an observable editorial property.
Discussion: distinguishes viewer comprehension from ranking.
Action: proposes measurement without a reach promise.
